description: MTA Bridges & Tunnels Daily E-ZPass Usage Rate by Vehicle Class: 2005-2024 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. This deprecated dataset provides data showing the number of vehicles (including cars, buses, trucks and motorcycles) using E-ZPass that pass through each of the nine bridges and tunnels operated by the MTA each day. The data is now shared by the hour at. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are vehicle class, toll plaza, day. The table has 35 columns. Attribution on the portal: Metropolitan Transportation Authority. The portal shows 2025-09-08 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
